remarks: Charming 1BR/1BA apartment with a private entrance. Features include recessed lighting and an open floor plan, creating a bright and inviting living space. This apartment was freshly painted, has new hall & bedroom carpeting installed and has a new bathroom shower along with new flooring! The kitchen offers ample cabinet storage and is equipped with a refrigerator, oven, and dishwasher. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit full size washer and dryer, and a full bath. Landlord covers water, sewer, trash, lawn care, and snow removal. Sorry, no pets. Ideally located on a quiet, sidewalk-lined street, just a short walk to restaurants, shopping, and more. Excellent commuter location with easy access to Route 7, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway. Off-street parking included. One-year lease. First month's rent and two months' security deposit due at lease signing. Available for October timing. Schedule your private showing today!
